name: deepx_generate_music
description: Generate complete studio-quality songs, background music, or soundtrack on Google Flow Music (flowmusic.app). Supports style reference locking (BPM, genre, instruments, vocals) to produce songs in identical consistent styles, and auto-downloads the audio track.

prompt.description: Song description, topic, mood, or musical style instruction.

style_reference.description: Sonic DNA / style lock (e.g. 'Lofi Chillhop, 82 BPM, warm rhodes, vinyl crackle, female vocal chops'). Used to keep multiple tracks musically consistent.

lyrics.description: Custom lyrics to sing. If omitted, Google Flow Music writes lyrics automatically.

instrumental.description: If true, generates an instrumental background track without vocals.

new_session.description: If true, creates a fresh new Flow Music session before submitting the song prompt.

auto_download.description: If true, automatically downloads the finished song file.
